name: diffview-search-latency
title: DiffView search: reduce jump and scan latency
description: Diff search stacks three both-sides multipliers on one main thread: scans ~2x bytes (both files concatenated into one engine.search), paints both panes per streamed progress batch, and a search-jump does a wasted synchronous double-pane render at the old position plus an async scroll-event+rAF round-trip before the destination paints. Reduce jump and scan latency.
creator: opencode
